title: Captain warns Sherman he won't be allowed out

tellings.quote: >> um, I honestly don't think you're going to be able to get out.

plain: A former US Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says that in the early 1990s, at a secret site he calls Base 2, a captain told him he honestly did not think Sherman would be able to get out. Sherman tells it to show how hard it was to leave the secret work he says he was doing, which involved communicating with beings from elsewhere.
